flow_ref: User story (not in any OCMS flow deck)
code_summary: ocmsadminui pages/Report/{index.tsx,action/ActionReport.tsx,lists/*} (court report titles with no path and no list page; the report API call is commented out), utils/models/Icourtmention.d.ts; ocmsadminapi crud/ocmsizdb/OcmsCourtCase. ocmsadminprivateapi, ocmseserviceapi, ocmseserviceui, thirdpartyapi: no concluded-court-case report
note: Requirement status is not given in stories.json (blank); the story is traced normally. The story asks for a report on concluded court cases with date range and mention outcome filters, downloadable/printable. The code has no such report. The staff portal has four titles 'Court Application Vault/Submit/Summon/Rejected Reports' in Report/index.tsx:61-76 with an empty path, there is no list component in pages/Report/lists, and the whole report API call in ActionReport.tsx:35-64 and 87-110 is commented out. There is no backend query for court cases and no mention outcome data (see OCMS26.6). The Daily/Monthly Paid reports do have a JTC sheet (DailyPaidReportHelper), but that is a payment report, not concluded court cases by mention outcome, so it is not credited. Ticket OCMS-DF-2026-194 (Open) mentions 'new court reports' as newly requested by URA, a hint that court reports do not exist yet. The 'DOS Reports' UI is not relevant: DOS = DataHive/LTA cannot be confirmed from the repo.
recommendation: Do not claim as complete. Ask URA/the team where the concluded court case report is built, or mark it as a gap. Reference: OCMS-DF-2026-194.

steps.step: The officer opens the concluded court case report menu
steps.detail: Four court report titles (Court Application Vault/Submit/Summon/Rejected) are registered in Report/index.tsx:61-76 with path "" and there is no list component for them in pages/Report/lists (which has HST, TS, PS, LTA, MHA etc.). No report named concluded or mention outcome exists. Synonyms grepped: concluded, court report, court summon, mention outcome, ReportListCourt.

steps.step: The officer picks standard output indicators (date range, mention outcome)
steps.detail: There is no court filter form. The schedule_start/schedule_end filter in ActionReport.tsx:87-110 sits in a commented-out block, and mention_outcome exists only as a TypeScript type (Icourtmention.d.ts:1-33) with no data in the backend.

steps.step: OCMS builds the concluded court case report from the filters
steps.detail: There is no court report controller, query or job in ocmsadminapi or ocmsadminprivateapi. The resource courtcasesummary named in the comments of ActionReport.tsx:35-64 has no backend implementation, and ocms_court_case only has notice_no, court_payment_due_date, reason (OcmsCourtCase.java:24-31), so concluded status and mention outcome cannot be queried.

steps.step: The officer downloads or prints the report
steps.detail: The generateReportAPI call (reports/.../excel, isReturnBlob) in ActionReport.tsx:87-110 is commented out for all types, so there is no download or print for the court report. The export mechanism of other reports (e.g. TS, PS) exists, but it is not the report the story names; not credited.
